---
title: "Contrasts"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmean)
library(mosaic)
library(car)
library(pander)
```

```{r}
Nicotine <- read_csv("../data/data_for_class/Data/Nicotine.csv")
View(Nicotine)
```

```{r}
Nicotine$Groups <- factor(Nicotine$Groups)
```

```{r}
myaov <- aov(Meconium~Groups, data = Nicotine)
#group_means <- emmeans(myaov, "Groups")
#contrast_results <- contrast(group_means, list(groups <- c(-1,1,0))
summary(myaov)
facstats(Meconium ~ Groups, data = Nicotine)
stripchart(Meconium ~ Groups, data = Nicotine, vertical = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mymeans <- emmeans(myaov, "Groups", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE))
symmary(emmeans)
```



```{r}
contrast_results <- contrast(mymeans, adjust = "none")
contrast_results
confint(contrast_results)
```


```{r}
contrast_results <- contrasts(mymeans, list(APvN = c(0.5,0.5,-1), AvP = c(1,-2,0)), adjust = "none")
contrast_results
confint(contrast_results())
```
